results.detail: 4:27 map tour in 10 chapters (Intro, La isla, El norte, El este, El sur, El oeste, El centro, Datos curiosos, Repaso, Final). Every one of the 37 segments checked in stills (plus the recap and the sign-off): the opening card 'TOUR COMPLETO · Todos los lugares del mapa' over the official map, the '17 lugares en el mapa oficial' card, both in-game news tiles quoted word for word and lit as they are read, five region overviews with their places pinned, 17 stops where the camera lands on the right spot (ring on the place; the five landmarks that have no label on the map get a yellow handwritten label), the records (más al norte, sur, oeste, este, más céntrico, más alejados, más pegados) each labelled, and a closing map whose 17 pins appear region by region as they are named. Fixed before passing: pin labels never showed in 16:9 (S.scrawl hides anything outside the 9:16 app-safe area), region overviews and records held too briefly, the final card touched the Villa Molino ring, and three labels collided with printed map names (now clear; 'EL MÁS CÉNTRICO' sits above the Caverna Condenada ring so it can't be read with 'Frontera Farol'). Name cards fit on one line (long names shrink), subtitles readable, #EpicPartner and the watermark in every frame, mid-roll and closing code cards clean, sign-off under the closing card. Voice says One Piece, Loguetown, Henry, Bote boogie, $.$. and Ace the way a Mexican player would; Spanish reads naturally.
Standing approval for autopilot (owner, 2026-10-28): posts when checks 1-7 all PASS.
